value.rationale: The two-parameter theorem shows that the new nonadditivity pathology is not caused by self-tensor symmetry. The smaller arm quantitatively controls a surviving obstruction, giving unbounded defects along unequal pairs such as \((r,2r)\). This is a natural structural strengthening of the motivating 2026 counterexample family rather than a routine parameter substitution.
